name: Compute Cluster S70: Fractional Differentiation
description: Tests: frac_diff(d, threshold), rolling_adf(window). Memory-preserving stationarity for ML features (Lopez de Prado AIFML Ch.5). Verify stationarity with ADF.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S70: Fractional Differentiation
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === FRACTIONAL DIFF AT DIFFERENT d VALUES ===
# Note: ideally applied to log(prices), but log() transform not available.
# frac_diff works on raw close prices too — it internally differences.
fd_03 = frac_diff(d=0.3, threshold=1e-2)(close)
fd_05 = frac_diff(d=0.5, threshold=1e-3)(close)
fd_07 = frac_diff(d=0.7, threshold=1e-5)(close)

# === VERIFY STATIONARITY ===
adf_03 = rolling_adf(window=100)(fd_03)
adf_05 = rolling_adf(window=100)(fd_05)

pval_03 = adf_03.p_value
pval_05 = adf_05.p_value

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Fractional Diff: d=0.3 vs d=0.5 vs d=0.7',
    category='FracDiff',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='d=0.3 (more memory)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='d=0.5 (balanced)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='d=0.7 (more stationary)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(fd_03, fd_05, fd_07))

xy_lines(
    title='ADF p-value: d=0.3 vs d=0.5',
    category='Stationarity',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='p-value (d=0.3)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='p-value (d=0.5)', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(pval_03, pval_05))
